[[File:Tissshar.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Two Tiss'shar, ''kal-ar'' (foreground) and ''[[sil-ar]]'' (background), at work.]]
The '''kal-ar''' were a common race among the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Their scales had thin, concentric bands, beginning at the base of their jaws and going all the way to their feet.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>
